fork_repository.rationale: Forks an existing repo to the user's account; copies existing content, no agent-supplied payload delivered.

create_branch.rationale: Creates a git ref; write side-effect with no agent-supplied data payload.

update_pull_request_branch.rationale: Updates a PR branch with the base branch; no agent-supplied content delivered.

notes: Archived reference server: NO configuration flags of any kind. Token comes from GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN env (dist/common/utils.js:28). No read-only mode, no toolsets, no lockdown/content-filter, no scope filtering => all 26 tools always enabled.
All 26 tools are hard-coded in the ListTools handler and dispatched in the CallTool switch (dist/index.js:54-188, 190-406); there is nothing to remove tools or labels.
Default label union = {SECRET, UNTRUSTED, SINK} => composes the forbidden flow with no mitigation available.

Primary: private-repo reads are SECRET, public/third-party reads are UNTRUSTED, writes to public repos/issues/PRs/comments are SINK. Secondary variant adds UNTRUSTED to SECRET-only reads (get_pull_request_status) since collaborators author those records.
fork_repository/create_branch/update_pull_request_branch are writes but carry no agent-chosen data to an attacker-readable place, so no SINK.
